name: calendar
description: Calendar Scheduling App - MERN Stack Monorepo

scripts.test: rm -rf output .cache/junit; JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=$PWD/.cache/junit JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=backend.xml bun run test:backend; backend=$?; [ -s .cache/junit/backend.xml ] || { echo "Backend tests ended without writing results."; backend=1; }; VITEST_JUNIT_FILE=$PWD/.cache/junit/frontend.xml bun run test:frontend; frontend=$?; [ -s .cache/junit/frontend.xml ] || { echo "Frontend tests ended without writing results."; frontend=1; }; mkdir -p output && jrm output/junit.xml '.cache/junit/*.xml'; merged=$?; exit $((backend || frontend || merged))
